description: A nested capture includes its own later suffix omission (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate) Y
%conditions begins(from(without-elision($x)), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival $y(body)
%conditions matches(without-elision($y), inner), ¬matches(without-elision($y), wrong)
%rule body X [+T] Y [+U]
%rule inner X [+T] Y [+U]
%rule wrong X [+T] Y
